what.text: This page follows refugees from Chad living in Sudan, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 933 Chadian refugees in Sudan, 6.1% of all refugees from Chad.
The Central African Republic hosts the most Chadian refugees, followed by France, Cameroon and Canada.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Chad in periods from 1966 to 2023.
It also records an interstate armed conflict between Chad and Libya in 1987, and armed conflict with the Islamic State group in some years since 2015.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1970 at 500 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 141400, at the end of 1993 and 1994; the main years of displacement in the data include 1984 to 1987.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Sudan.
These are year-end totals for Sudan only, reported to UNHCR.
